description: User starts confused about probation, asks legal questions under Kenya Employment Act, and reviews extension rules.
turns: I just started my first job at an NGO in Nairobi. What should I know about probation?
My manager said my probation is 6 months, but might be extended to 8 months. Is that legal?
Okay, thanks! I will review Section 42 of my contract terms today and ask HR for written clarification.
expected_outcome: Session resolves with clear statutory rights on probation caps and written consent rules.

description: User describes a suspicious job offer requiring M-Pesa payments for uniform fees.
turns: I got a job offer for data entry paying KES 80k per month!
They asked me to send KES 2,500 via M-Pesa for a training uniform before my start date. Is that required?
Ah I see that is a major red flag. I will not send any money and will report the recruiter.
expected_outcome: User adopts protective behavior and refrains from sending fees via M-Pesa.

description: Graduate preparing for first day at commercial bank vs tech startup.
turns: I landed my first role at a bank in Upper Hill. What should I wear on Day 1?
What if I'm not sure about Friday casual wear rules?
Got it! I will wear formal business attire for week 1 and observe workplace norms.
expected_outcome: User understands dress code norms per industry type and day-one logistics.

description: Employee accidentally sent internal draft email to wrong recipient.
turns: I accidentally sent an internal draft email to the wrong person 😭 What should I do?
Should I call my manager immediately or send a written apology first?
Understood. I will send a brief, polite email clarifying the mistake and notify my manager.
expected_outcome: User receives calm, professional crisis management advice without panic.

description: Early career employee feeling ignored by direct supervisor.
turns: My manager barely speaks to me during my first month. Does that mean she dislikes my work?
How should I approach her for a 1-on-1 feedback check-in?
Thanks! I'll send a brief calendar invite asking for a 15-minute alignment check.
expected_outcome: Reframes manager silence around competing priorities and provides feedback framework.

description: First payslip breakdown explaining statutory deductions in Kenya.
turns: I received my first payslip and noticed deductions for SHA, NSSF, and Housing Levy. Are these compulsory?
What percentage of my gross income is deducted for NSSF under current regulations?
Clear! I now understand net vs gross salary statutory calculations.
expected_outcome: Accurate statutory breakdown of Kenyan payroll deductions.

description: Recruiter demanding KES 3,500 for medical check-up at specific clinic.
turns: An interviewer told me I passed the final round but need to pay KES 3,500 for a medical check-up at their clinic.
Is medical screening payment normal during hiring in Kenya?
I'll inform them that mandatory medical checks must be employer-funded.
expected_outcome: Triggers scam alert regarding pre-employment medical fee scams.

description: Employee asking about paid annual leave rights under Section 28.
turns: How many days of paid annual leave am I entitled to per year in Kenya?
Can my employer force me to forfeit my unused leave days at the end of the year?
Great to know Section 28 protects 21 working days of paid annual leave.
expected_outcome: Grounded legal explanation of annual leave entitlements under Section 28.

description: Junior employee struggling with hybrid remote work communication.
turns: I am working remotely 3 days a week. How do I make sure my team knows I'm working hard?
What tools should I use for daily status updates?
I will share a 3-bullet daily summary in our Slack channel every evening.
expected_outcome: Provides actionable remote work visibility and communication practices.

description: Employee asked to work 60 hours a week without extra pay.
turns: I am working 60 hours a week including Saturdays. Am I legally entitled to overtime pay?
What is the statutory overtime rate on public holidays in Kenya?
I will check my contract overtime clause and track my daily working hours.
expected_outcome: Explains legal working hours (45-52 hrs/wk) and overtime rate multipliers.

description: Software engineer feeling out of depth during technical onboarding.
turns: Everyone on my team seems so smart while I take twice as long to finish tickets. Am I failing?
How do I ask senior devs for help without looking incompetent?
I will use the 30-minute debugging rule before asking for assistance.
expected_outcome: Empathetic coaching reframing imposter syndrome into structured learning habits.

description: Salary delayed by 12 days past expected pay date.
turns: Our pay date is the 30th, but it's now the 12th of next month and salary hasn't arrived. What are my options?
What does the Kenya Employment Act say about timely payment of wages?
I'll write a polite query to Finance copying HR to ask for an estimated disbursement date.
expected_outcome: Explains Section 17 wage payment rules and professional follow-up steps.

description: Understanding summary dismissal vs fair hearing procedures.
turns: Can an employer fire me on the spot without a disciplinary meeting?
What acts constitute gross misconduct under Section 44 of the Employment Act?
Understood. Section 41 guarantees the right to a fair hearing and representation.
expected_outcome: Grounded legal explanation of Section 41 & 44 termination procedures.

description: New parent inquiring about parental leave rights.
turns: What are the statutory maternity and paternity leave periods in Kenya?
Does maternity leave affect my annual leave entitlement?
Clear! 3 months maternity and 2 weeks paternity leave do not reduce annual leave.
expected_outcome: Grounded legal explanation of Sections 29 & 30 parental leave.

description: Resigning from probation vs permanent contract.
turns: I received a better job offer. How much notice do I need to give while on probation?
What if I want to resign immediately without serving notice?
Section 42 specifies 7 days notice or 7 days pay in lieu during probation.
expected_outcome: Explains Section 35 & 42 notice period and pay-in-lieu rules.

description: Understanding NDA obligations when switching companies.
turns: My contract has a non-compete and NDA clause. Can I work for a competitor in Nairobi?
What information is strictly considered proprietary data?
I'll ensure I don't share client lists or internal source code from my previous employer.
expected_outcome: Practical advice on IP, NDA boundaries, and ethical career transitions.

description: Handling inappropriate workplace behavior and reporting channels.
turns: A senior colleague keeps making uncomfortable personal comments about my appearance.
How do I document these incidents officially before speaking to HR?
I will keep a written log with dates and times and consult HR confidentially.
expected_outcome: Protective, professional guidance on documentation and HR reporting.

description: Navigating a 30-day Performance Improvement Plan.
turns: My manager put me on a 30-day Performance Improvement Plan (PIP). Does this mean I am getting fired?
How can I turn a PIP into a positive outcome?
I will agree on measurable daily metrics with my manager and document weekly progress.
expected_outcome: Constructive reframing of PIP into objective goals and documentation.

description: Contractor agreement vs employee statutory rights.
turns: I signed an Independent Contractor Agreement. Do I get statutory health insurance and paid leave?
What is the key legal difference between a contract of service and contract for service?
Understood. Contractors handle their own taxes (Withholding Tax) and benefits.
expected_outcome: Distinguishes Contract of Service (employee) vs Contract for Service (consultant).

description: Structuring a 30-day check-in conversation with direct supervisor.
turns: I have completed my first 30 days. How should I ask my supervisor for constructive feedback?
What specific questions should I ask during our check-in?
I will ask: What should I keep doing, stop doing, and start doing?
expected_outcome: Actionable feedback framework (Start / Stop / Continue model).
